silverFlames.title: A ​Court of Silver Flames
silverFlames.author: Sarah J. Maas
silverFlames.sourceAccess: Official page indexed content readable through web tool; direct Node fetch 403 challenge, not bypassed.
silverFlames.diagnosis: Exact OL edition has no description. Unkeyed exact-ISBN Google Books probes returned 429 here. This demonstrates a failing provider fallback, not the definitive upstream cause on production. Transport failure remains distinct from missing description for other books.
silverFlames.change: Own short English summary, pinned to exact Work/Edition/ISBN/title/author/eng. Shared SSR/API resolver. NL permitted English fallback receives English text with existing translated label, never relabelled Dutch. Zero provider requests for this reviewed identity.

risks: Five Google Books cover images are 128px wide; correct identity and light thumbnails but visibly soft at large detail size. No upscaling or unverified larger substitute.
External cover availability remains outside application control; failures retain neutral fallback.
No production deployment or hosted build of this branch; proof is local against existing isolated test catalog.
No usage-rights assessment implied by source verification.
